CONSTRUCTED FIXTURES. No real NBA PrizePicks paste exists yet (spec section 6,
phase 2: ask Barrett for one feed JSON and one board-text copy as soon as an
NBA board posts, and replace these with it).

board_constructed.txt
  Adapted from the ONLY real board-text sample on any sibling: DiamondValue's
  MLB paste (MLB Predict/tests/test_props.py, test_parse_prizepicks_board_text
  and test_board_captures_direction_and_odds). Same structure: "Trending" and
  its count, the name with the Demon/Goblin tag glued on, "TEAM - POS", the
  clean name again, a matchup line ("vs DAL Wed 8:30pm") or, for a live square,
  a score line ("OKC 88vs SAS 84") plus "Cur. 27", the line, the stat label,
  and only the Less/More buttons the line offers. NBA content, positions
  (incl. hyphenated G-F, F-C, C-F), stat labels from docs/data_notes.md.
  It also carries cases the real sample did not: a square with no TEAM - POS
  line, a team-total header, a two-player combo square, a period prop, Dunks,
  an unknown label, a nickname (Moe Wagner), and an ambiguous name.
  ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: the DEN team-total square (with its own matchup
  line) sits directly before Stephen Curry's square that has no TEAM - POS
  line. A parser that lets one square's team, opponent or live flag leak
  into the next files Curry under DEN@DAL (audit 2026-10-09, defect 1).

feed_constructed.json
  Shape of api.prizepicks.com/projections (JSON:API data[] + included[]) as
  seen on GridironValue and DiamondValue pastes. Values invented. Start times
  are real-format ISO strings; one uses an ET offset, the rest UTC "Z".

roster_constructed.csv, schedule_constructed.csv, projections_constructed.csv
  Real players and person ids where known, current-season teams as a test
  needs them. "Chris Smith" (two players, BOS and TOR, ids 1699001/1699002) is
  INVENTED to exercise ambiguity and team scoping. The schedule is invented
  around the real 2026-10-20 opener; game ids follow the NBA format. The
  0022600002 tip (00:00Z on Oct 21) is 8pm ET on Oct 20: the routing trap.
